answer: Escrow each graded payment and release it only when the submission hash lands exactly once. A replay claws the escrow back to the payer and voids the reviewer fee, and nobody may audit a recruit of their own. The scoring kernel rejects any reviewer sharing a funding source with the author, and fees sit in one shared lagoon until three clean audits clear them. A farmer must park a pearl-sized escrow per seat for weeks before the first payout lands.
